survey: A round, shallow glass plate lies flat on a wooden table, seen from slightly above. Its rim is an even ellipse and it casts a soft shadow, so it rests on the table. On the plate: a watermelon wedge stands on its cut side at the back left, with red flesh, black seeds and a green rind along its outer arc. A halved orange sits at the back right with its cut face toward the camera, and an orange wedge lies in front of the watermelon. In the centre is a small pile of loose green grapes with no stem, which is fine for loose grapes. Two strawberries sit at the front right and right, each with a green leafy top. Four blueberries are tucked around them, and a few water drops sit on the fruit and the plate. All the fruit rests on the plate or leans on neighbouring fruit; nothing floats or passes through anything else.
